newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan chamber expresses grave concern on stocks.
newsitem.headline: Japan chamber expresses grave concern on stocks.

text.p: Japan will face "grave problems" in the run up to corporate book closings at the end of March if Tokyo stocks fall further, Jiji news agency quoted Kosaku Inaba, chairman of the Japan Chamber of Commerce, as saying on Thursday.

"If stocks fall further, it would be a grave problem ahead of corporate book closing at the end of March," Inaba was quoted by Jiji as telling a news conference. He said the stock market was now in a very worrisome situation.

"It's very regrettable to see the current triple weakness (in the yen, stocks and bonds). Stock prices are falling, initiated by foreign sales and I feel the market is severely criticising the current state of the economy," Inaba was quoted as saying.
